synopsis: Behold, a great detective who thrills the world solving impossible cases in no time! His name? Keiichiro Nagumo. …But all of that was over a decade ago. Now he's just your typical middle-aged dude. Nagumo is behind the times to the point that he doesn't even know what a smartphone is. But out of the blue, he is confronted by a high school girl named Mashiro who shows up wanting to be his assistant. Witness the miracles a gender-gap detective duo can make! synopsis: Natsume Ichika is a very ordinary high school girl who once had a close childhood friend, Maki Saihara. However, the two became estranged and have not spoken to each other for more than a year. When they both end up in the same class and both become members of the gardening committee, Ichika sees an opportunity to make up with Maki. However, Maki still refuses to even make eye contact with her… Until one day, when Maki suddenly comes over to Ichika's house. She wanted to show Ichika something unexpected: cat ears growing out of her head! A high school girl who loves cats and a childhood friend who has become as carefree as a cat herself. A story about a slightly mysterious "curse" is about to start! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

synopsis: Alban realizes that he had been reincarnated as the “villainous nobleman” of a fantasy novel. Just as he starts rigorously training in sword and sorcery so that he would not be defeated by the hero, Alban finds out that Leticia, the daughter of the villain, is to be his bride! Leticia is a young lady who is the subject of many unsavory rumors! He was scared to see what kind of “bad girl” she would be… But when he meets her, she seems pure and beautiful as an angel, almost like his ideal woman. Alban is so smitten that he forgets all about his plan to avoid the bad ending. He decides to strike back at the mastermind behind his beloved wife's downfall! Using their own villainous reputation to their advantage, he sets a trap to lure out the culprit......? (Source: Corona EX, translated)
